IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.external_file_formats WHERE name = 'SynapseParquetFormat') 
	CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT [SynapseParquetFormat] 
	WITH ( FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET)
GO

-- GO

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.titanic (
	[PassengerId] bigint,
	[Survived] bigint,
	[Pclass] bigint,
	[Name] nvarchar(4000),
	[Sex] nvarchar(4000),
	[Age] float,
	[SibSp] bigint,
	[Parch] bigint,
	[Ticket] nvarchar(4000),
	[Fare] float,
	[Cabin] nvarchar(4000),
	[Embarked] nvarchar(4000)
	)
	WITH (
	LOCATION = 'Raw/titanic.parquet',
	DATA_SOURCE = [quant-container_quantcloudstorage_dfs_core_windows_net],
	FILE_FORMAT = [SynapseParquetFormat]
	)
GO


SELECT TOP 100 * FROM dbo.titanic
GO
